outcome: operative delivery (instrumental delivery or cesarean section)
cohort: 200 nulliparous women with singleton, cephalic, term pregnancies
finding: Ultrasound assessment of fetal head circumference (FHC) at the onset of labor was highly correlated with post-delivery neonatal head circumference and FHC ≥350 mm was associated with more than twice the risk of any operative delivery and a two-fold increased risk of cesarean section for dystocia.
